easyPrerequisites: On Serra's Wings attached to Boonweaver Giant.
description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to On Serra's Wings, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning On Serra's Wings from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
